#!/usr/bin/env bun
// Generated by crewhaus. DO NOT EDIT.
// Source spec: "pin-cli-memory" (target: cli, ir version: 0)
import { formatRunFailure, toFailureReport } from "@crewhaus/errors";
import { runChatLoop } from "@crewhaus/runtime-core";
import { defaultCatalog } from "@crewhaus/tool-catalog";
import { read } from "@crewhaus/tool-fs";
import { wireMemory } from "@crewhaus/memory-service";
import { loadHooks } from "@crewhaus/hooks-engine";
import { discoverSkills, createSkillTool } from "@crewhaus/skills-registry";
import { loadCommands } from "@crewhaus/slash-commands";

defaultCatalog.register(read);

const __cwd = process.cwd();
const [__hooks, __skills, __slashCommands] = await Promise.all([
  loadHooks({ cwd: __cwd }),
  discoverSkills({ cwd: __cwd }),
  loadCommands({ cwd: __cwd }),
]);
if (__skills.length > 0) defaultCatalog.register(createSkillTool(__skills));

const __memWired = await wireMemory({"specName":"pin-cli-memory","memory":{"autoCapture":true,"autoRecall":true,"recallK":4}}, { catalog: defaultCatalog, cwd: process.cwd() });

try {
  await runChatLoop({
    model: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
    instructions: "You are a byte-restore pin fixture for the CLI shape with memory. Reply concisely.\n",
    sessionName: "pin-cli-memory",
    sessionTarget: "cli",
    tools: defaultCatalog.list(),
    hooks: __hooks,
    skills: __skills,
    slashCommands: __slashCommands,
    ...__memWired.options,
  });
} catch (__err) {
  const __report = toFailureReport(__err);
  process.stderr.write(`${formatRunFailure(__report)}\n`);
  process.exit(__report.exitCode);
}
